attempts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE original standalone vertical fan-art character illustration for the Kalistar x Final Fantasy proposal collection. Illustration only, NOT a card, collage or character sheet. Portrait 4:5 composition for a future 737 x 921 art window.
ART DIRECTION: match Kalistar's visually inspected Momo/Valazar painterly family and the approved FFIX paintings. Dense expressive hand-painted brushwork, broken color planes and selective crisp edges, believable painted anatomy, worn fabric/leather/metal, luminous but matte pigment. This must visibly be a richly textured narrative painting, NOT a photo, NOT a photoreal person/cosplay, NOT smooth CGI, anime or manga. Grain comes from brush strokes, never an artificial uniform noise overlay. Preserve each named Final Fantasy character's recognizable canonical costume and distinguishing features; do not turn everyone into medieval soldiers.
An emotional lived moment with motivated light. Background restrained to two or three broad evocative shapes, no busy architecture, repeated towers or ornamental filler. Character and gesture central, head/essential hands and equipment within central 70 percent and plenty of crop room; natural anatomy with exactly two arms and two hands, credible grip and object contact. Long straight blades/shafts may extend outside the image, never bend or shorten them to fit. Do not add flags. No text, numbers, logos, watermark, card border, game interface or crystal medallion.
SUBJECT, SCENE AND COMPOSITION:
Terra Branford from Final Fantasy VI in her recognizable Esper/Trance transformation: magical humanoid form with opaque pink-lilac fur-like covering over the entire body, long wild pale lavender hair, pointed ears, bright blue eyes, small golden claw tips. Adult heroine, nonsexual depiction, no visible intimate anatomy, opaque magical coverage and a few luminous strands. New scene and pose: descending gently onto a broken stone platform high above Zozo, feet almost touching, shoulders turned and one hand reaching toward the first sunlight, expression overwhelmed but lucid. Three-quarter nearly full figure, rose-violet magic contained around forearms, calm gray dawn sky and ONE distant roof silhouette only. No wings, no horns, no armor suit, no explosion.
